text: for sake of what we have in the app already will u mock in hundreds of materials so i can see what happens when we have a lot in here
resolution: Expanded the hmsc workspace mock material catalog to stress the browser with hundreds of materials. Added a generated 240-entry material bank behind the core named materials, changed the no-scroll page size to 12, made catalog search cover material recipes, added visible range/total page text, and added an empty state for searches with no matches. Verified with cart bundle and raw ReleaseFast ship; generated build artifacts were removed.
